args.title: Bellwether Office Newsletter Summary – Cold-chain logistics 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter (Bellwether Office): Highlights this week's focus on cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to an in-depth article on the topic.
- Linked article ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): Carriers that shared live sensor data saw temperature excursions fall 30%; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Reports that pilot programs using this approach cut claims by roughly a quarter.
